extracted.name: Air fryer broccoli
extracted.description: Use your air fryer to cook broccoli. With garlic and paprika seasoning for flavour, it's a speedy way to get your greens in and makes a versatile side dish
ingredient_lines: 1 stalk or 450g broccoli broken into florets, stalk roughly chopped
instruction_lines: Put the broccoli in a bowl, drizzle with olive oil, spices and sprinkle with plenty of salt and pepper. Mix with your hands well to coat, then put into the basket of an air-fryer, making sure they’re in one layer.
Heat to 180c and air-fry for 8-10 mins, shaking halfway.
